Message:
drm/dp: drop the size parameter from drm_dp_vsc_sdp_pack()

Currently the size parameter of drm_dp_vsc_sdp_pack() is always
the size of struct dp_sdp. Hence lets drop this parameter and
use sizeof() directly.
